neighbours.label: Dense background unit: weakly on (about 0.2-0.5 of max) for almost any running text in any language, whether prose, citations or code, with no single word or meaning driving it; a little higher on year digits written right after Chinese characters (2009年) and on punctuation inside citations.
neighbours.notes: Gate-closed echo side of a pole whose - side is ~90x larger. Card flags it dense (33% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Probes: number/no-number twins tied (citation 0.30 vs 0.31; 'back in 1962' 0.45 vs 'back when' 0.45); 'Yes.' 0.19. Feeder chosen from the resident feeders ranking because play step hit CUDA OOM; no ablation weight. Test written blind from the label only.
